```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(knitr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Rostered player-seasons on one team, 2016 through the last complete season,
# the same window as the absence signal so the two shares share a base.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
game_window <- 2016:complete_through
store <- file.path(root, "_targets")
player_game <- targets::tar_read(player_game, store = store)
usage <- targets::tar_read(player_usage, store = store)
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
games <- dbReadTable(con, "games")
names_by_id <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, any_value(player) AS player
   FROM game_player_stats GROUP BY playerId"
)
pos_levels <- setdiff(
  harmonized_position_levels(),
  c("Athlete", "Position not recorded")
)
no_usage <- setdiff(pos_levels, usage_signal_map()$position_group)
pos_seasons <- usage |>
  filter(on_roster, team_games > 0, season %in% game_window) |>
  group_by(playerId, season) |>
  filter(n() == 1L) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(position_group %in% pos_levels) |>
  select(playerId, season, team, position_group)
absence <- player_appearance_sequence(player_game, roster, games) |>
  filter(season %in% game_window) |>
  absence_runs(
    streak = formals(absence_runs)$streak,
    min_gap = formals(absence_runs)$min_gap
  ) |>
  inner_join(pos_seasons, by = c("playerId", "season", "team")) |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, pos_levels))
absence_by_pos <- absence_summary(absence)
decline <- player_game |>
  filter(season %in% game_window) |>
  usage_decline(
    pos_seasons,
    min_games = formals(usage_decline)$min_games,
    ratio = formals(usage_decline)$ratio
  ) |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, pos_levels))
decline_by_pos <- decline_summary(decline, absence_by_pos)
signals_by_pos <- absence_by_pos |>
  select(position_group, injury_shaped) |>
  inner_join(
    select(decline_by_pos, position_group, declined),
    by = "position_group"
  )

p <- signals_by_pos |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(declined, injury_shaped),
    names_to = "signal",
    values_to = "share"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    signal = if_else(
      signal == "declined",
      "Benching-shaped decline",
      "Injury-shaped absence"
    ),
    tip = sprintf("%s, %s: %s", position_group, signal, pct(share))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = share,
    y = forcats::fct_rev(position_group),
    fill = signal
  )) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, signal)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      `Benching-shaped decline` = "#374151",
      `Injury-shaped absence` = "#9CA3AF"
    ),
    labels = c("Benching-shaped", "Injury-shaped")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Is a benching-shaped decline rarer than an injury-shaped absence?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Each signal's share is among the seasons that can show it; ",
      paste(tolower(no_usage), collapse = " and "),
      " are left out, having no usage count"
    ),
    x = "Share of seasons that can show it",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "benching-vs-injury-shape", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: quarterback-figure
# Every quarterback season that can show a decline, plotted by its pass
# attempts per game in the two halves of the season it appeared in.
qb <- decline |>
  filter(observable, position_group == "Quarterback") |>
  left_join(names_by_id, by = "playerId") |>
  mutate(
    status = if_else(declined, "Benching-shaped decline", "No decline"),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s %s: %.1f pass attempts a game in the first half, %.1f in the second (%s games)",
      coalesce(player, playerId),
      team,
      season,
      first_half,
      second_half,
      games_appeared
    )
  )
p_qb <- ggplot(qb, aes(first_half, second_half, colour = status)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 0.5, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(playerId, season, team)),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(`Benching-shaped decline` = "#374151", `No decline` = "#9CA3AF")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Which quarterback seasons show a benching-shaped decline?",
    subtitle = "Every quarterback season that can show a decline; below the dashed line, usage halved",
    x = "Pass attempts per game, first half of games appeared",
    y = "Pass attempts per game, second half",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_qb)
```

```{r}
#| label: signals-table
decline_by_pos |>
  left_join(
    select(absence_by_pos, position_group, injury_shaped),
    by = "position_group"
  ) |>
  arrange(position_group) |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = as.character(position_group),
    `Usage count` = usage_label,
    `Decline can be read` = pct(readable),
    `Benching-shaped decline` = pct(declined),
    `Injury-shaped absence` = pct(injury_shaped)
  ) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Position group",
      "Usage count",
      "Decline can be read",
      "Benching-shaped decline",
      "Injury-shaped absence"
    ),
    align = "llrrr",
    caption = paste0(
      "Rostered player-seasons, ",
      min(game_window),
      " to ",
      max(game_window),
      ". ",
      paste(tolower(no_usage), collapse = " and "),
      " have no usage count, so a decline cannot be read for them. Each share is among the seasons that can show that signal."
    )
  )
```
